Expression functions: len, contains, sta: Expression functions: len, contains, startswith, endswith, upper, lower and concat. Fires when the value changes. Operator a: Löst bei Wertänderung aus; Operator und Schwelle werden ignoriert. Fehlende und erste wiederhergestellte Werte lösen nicht aus.
Focus the shortcut box and press Ctrl or: Focus the shortcut box and press Ctrl or Alt with a letter, digit or function key, then Save & Apply. F12 and reserved combinations are rejected. If registration conflicts, the previous shortcut remains active. Clear and save to disable it.

Global Scale changes the whole HUD size;: Global Scale changes the whole HUD size; opacity controls its visibility. Font selection changes text rendering, with system fallback for missing glyphs. Hot zones are available with Always Visi: Hot zones are available with Always Visible off. Set the anchor, size, offsets and dwell time. The region uses full target-display bounds and is clamped to the screen. Dwell for the chosen interval to summon; leave and re-enter to re-arm. You may advance the carousel on each summon.
ICMP uses Ping; TCP measures connect lat: ICMP nutzt Ping; TCP misst Verbindungsaufbau, UDP sendet Daten und wartet auf Dienstantwort.
Imported startup preference could not be: Importierte Startoption nicht anwendbar. Windows-Autostart prüfen.
In AIDA64 Preferences → Hardware Monitor: In AIDA64 Preferences → Hardware Monitoring → External Applications, select the items and enable shared memory, Registry or WMI. Keep AIDA64 running, then refresh ECP Hardware Data. ECP reads all actual exports, including numbers, timings and text; unexported or license-limited fields remain unavailable.
Initial and recovered samples establish: Initial and recovered samples establish a baseline without popping up. Network profiles can use automatic byte: Network profiles can use automatic byte units or Mbps; 1 MB/s equals 8 Mbps. The ring compares total, download, upload or the larger direction with your reference bandwidth. The reference sets the 100% scale and does not limit or benchmark the network.

Once equivalent hardware fields are disc: Once equivalent hardware fields are discovered, duplicate legacy entries leave the library while existing profiles keep working. New keys identify a specific device and sensor. Highest/average summaries have different meanings and remain separate. -- means no valid value is currently available.
One CPU/GPU may expose package, core, ho: One CPU/GPU may expose package, core, hotspot, memory and multiple power channels. Similar names can represent different measurements. Sensor min/max values are session history, not hardware limits. SMBIOS module information comes from firmware and is not a complete SPD/XMP/EXPO timing table.
Open the config folder from the top bar: Open the config folder from the top bar and the logs folder from About. Keep source status or hardware diagnostics when troubleshooting. Reset loads first-run defaults; Save & Apply commits them to the running app.
Ordinary clocks use local time. World Cl: Ordinary clocks use local time. World Clock uses a fixed UTC offset without automatic DST. Daily-target mode shows the remaining fraction until the next target time in the chosen zone; with it off, it shows elapsed day progress.

Place the key in braces, followed by | a: Place the key in braces, followed by | and a display format. Use 0 for integers and 0.0 / 0.00 for fixed decimals. Literal text may surround tokens. Formatting changes display only.

Profiles, positions, queues, trigger rul: Profiles, positions, queues, trigger rules and hot zones belong to each instance. Clicking a HUD advances only its queue. Sampling interval, global shortcut and the click-cycling master setting are shared. Save & Apply commits the whole configuration.

Refresh and select a window/display targ: Refresh and select a window/display target, then set the full-scale FPS. Window FPS uses the process's dominant swap chain; display FPS uses its dominant presentation stream, not the fixed refresh rate. Missing events or permissions produce status information; administrator access may be needed. Ordinary GPU profiles can select an adapter, while raw sensor keys identify their stated device.

Tagline, title, primary/secondary text a: Tagline, title, primary/secondary text and the right-side value can mix literal text and variable tokens. Use the right suffix for units such as %, °C or GHz. Icons identify the content; the accent color sets the capsule and ring color.
Targets may be hostnames, IPv4 or IPv6. ICMP ignores the port; TCP/UDP use it. Failure means that target/protocol did not respond successfully, not necessarily that the whole PC is offline. Servers may block ICMP or not reply to UDP.
The checkbox permanently silences only t: The checkbox permanently silences only the variables already listed in the current warning window. Other variables still warn. Closing normally acknowledges that incident. Multiple HUDs can share one warning window; expression faults are distinguished by profile and expression. Suppression does not repair or stop collection.

Shows hardware readings provided by the: Zeigt Messwerte, die System und Treiber tatsächlich bereitstellen. Nicht offengelegte oder unzugängliche Sensoren erscheinen als --. Weitere Einzelheiten enthält der Diagnoseexport. PawnIO und die AIDA64-Schnittstelle sind nur unter Windows verfügbar.
Es werden native Hardwareschnittstellen des Systems verwendet. Verfügbare Daten hängen von Hardware, Treibern und Berechtigungen ab; PawnIO wird nicht benötigt.
Shows readings actually provided by the: Zeigt tatsächlich vom Gerät und System bereitgestellte Werte. Nicht verfügbare Einträge zeigen -- und den Grund an.
This build has no native media-session d: Dieser Build bietet auf dieser Plattform keine native Datenquelle für Mediensitzungen. Medienfelder bleiben nicht verfügbar.
